recover-adopt-original-with-work.scope: Only matching adoption operation markers under continuously held both-home/profile admission. Source work generations, source snapshots and opaque backups must remain unchanged. A launched or migrated source refuses automatic rollback.

import-retained-lan-history.scope: Explicit settled readable-history import only, including safe rich display cards and full informational snapshots of operational cards. Fresh opaque backups of both homes and all present profiles. Source LAN is idle/read-only; selected original may preserve known unfinished work. Staged event/projector append only; no credential/settings/provider-process/runs/requests/subagent/outbox merge, no cancellation/resume, no binary/home/profile selection change.

recover-import-retained-lan-history.scope: Recover finishes only a matching reviewed staged/raw publication under held admission. No native journal/receipt permits only a no-op rolled-back result when a fresh domain review still matches. Rollback requires exact recorded post-import original generation plus unchanged source/profiles/selection; restore the pre-import SQLite set and quarantine newly imported immutable attachment files. Unknown or newer state refuses. All backups and quarantine bytes remain retained.

discovery.customOriginalHome: preview --original-home ABSOLUTE_PATH only; native Apply currently refuses a nondefault plan

hostAdmission.required: Hub establishes stopped process/profile quiescence and holds every handle continuously through helper exit, failure recovery and selection/pointer reconciliation. Conflicting helper opens are a protocol sanity check, not holder authentication.
hostAdmission.processes: No original or LAN backend, Electron process, profile writer or repair/activation may run concurrently. Never kill by name or override a failed admission.
hostAdmission.work: Ordinary Apply remains idle-only. Explicit retain-selected-lan and adopt-original-with-work require known stopped work, exact supported schema/projections and unchanged durable work generations. No provider, scheduler or worker is launched.
hostAdmission.userContext: Run helper and selected app as the original interactive Windows user. Do not run as a service or another user: DPAPI/private profile compatibility has not been verified across users.

selection.receipt: Contains bounded public path/digest metadata and opaque snapshot locations; startup requires its selection hash and both recorded identities to match.
selection.launch: Hub active pointer homeDirectory and environmentId must equal the helper's selected result. Set T3CODE_HOME to that home. Keep installer/version root independent. Do not rewrite either environment-id. T3 derives Electron profile from the selection manifest.
selection.activationJournal: For original .t3 use <selected-home>/native-activation.json. Existing separate LAN home continues using LOCALAPPDATA/T3CodeLAN/activation.json.
selection.startupBinding: T3 rechecks selection while holding startup admission; stale pre-admission home choices are refused.

defaultResolution.fresh: Use original .t3 and normal native-maintenance empty-home bootstrap with its native-activation.json journal; home-repair Apply is unnecessary and remains disabled.
defaultResolution.original-only: Use initialized original home and matching original Electron context.
defaultResolution.lan-only: Continue the existing LAN home and its electron-profile; never create an empty original home or regenerate its existing identity. Explicit side-by-side-retain-original Apply is supported with originalEnvironmentId:null.
defaultResolution.split: Require explicit reviewed home selection, preserve both complete initialized homes.

retention.behavior: Both complete original and LAN homes plus matching profiles and fresh opaque backups are retained. Explicit import may append settled readable LAN conversations to the selected original; it never merges credentials, provider environments, operational work or settings.
retention.access: Hub can explicitly select side-by-side-retain-original in a new stopped transaction to reopen retained LAN conversations and its existing Claude provider settings. Selecting adopt-original-retain-lan switches back. Every switch uses a fresh preview and repairId, backs up both current states and retains both histories.
retention.limitation: Retained histories remain separate unless the user explicitly reviews import-retained-lan-history. Only readable settled conversation history and immutable attachments are imported; provider credentials/settings remain separate and are never merged.
retention.rollback: Rollback journals its selection restoration and can recover either side of an interrupted rollback while all source snapshots are unchanged. Any new work or durable schema/profile write refuses automatic data restoration; backups remain for reviewed recovery.
retention.verification: Apply returns selected-pending-verification. Hub must validate selected environment, readable old history and saved connection continuity using the normal app before reporting repair complete; restoredHistoryVerified remains false in this interface.
retention.lanOnly: When original is missing/empty, explicit LAN retention backs up and validates the initialized LAN home and existing profiles only. Its retained-original path may remain absent. It does not restore missing original conversations.

release.reason: Requires matching Hub admission/selection/pointer/recovery UI, production artifact policy/hash pins, scoped checks and release review. Do not publish preview-only or claim verified repair.

previewAdditions.canCancelOriginalWork: boolean offer; full native checks still authoritative

cancellation.scope: Only current user default original .t3; retained LAN home must remain idle and unchanged. Enabled schedules and deferred/restart work are refused.
cancellation.ownership: One actual Hub-owned session holds installation and native admission continuously across all child calls and awaits child exit before disposal. Child verifies live actual parent PID and conflicting Windows kernel opens, never a caller boolean alone.
cancellation.sequence: After cancellation, obtain a fresh preview and ordinary Apply with a DIFFERENT new repair ID. Retain both receipts. Rollback ordinary selection before cancellation rollback; never overwrite newer work.
cancellation.journal: home-repair.json operation=cancel-original-work, schemaVersion1, repairId and receiptPath; unresolved journal blocks startup until recover-work-cancellation restores original snapshot state.
cancellation.history: Opaque complete original-home snapshot; domain lifecycle cancellation and command receipts append without deleting conversations/messages/attachments/session records. No provider, scheduler or worker runs.

previewAdditions.canAdoptOriginalWithWork: boolean offer requiring initialized original, matching original profile and known work in each initialized home

adoptionWithWork.receipt: schemaVersion1 distinct operation=adopt-original-with-work; expectedOriginalEnvironmentId, expectedLanEnvironmentId, sourceWorkGenerations keyed by initialized home, originalWorkGeneration and stagedOriginalWorkGeneration plus ordinary selection and opaque snapshot metadata.
adoptionWithWork.journal: home-repair.json retains the same distinct operation, identities and sourceWorkGenerations before backup/staging. Ordinary rollback/recover must not process an adoption marker.
adoptionWithWork.generations: originalWorkGeneration and stagedOriginalWorkGeneration use the exact NativeMaintenance update workGeneration algorithm and must match. Staged migrations may change staged database bytes/dataGeneration. Both source homes and profiles remain unchanged through adoption; Hub compares their pre/post native data/work generations. Later normal candidate verification may migrate the selected source and change dataGeneration, while durable workGeneration must remain equal.
adoptionWithWork.recovery: Interrupted adoption/pending-selection recovery requires pre-adoption source work generations and unchanged source/backups. Any later source migration or new work refuses automatic rollback, retaining backups for reviewed recovery.
adoptionWithWork.originalOnly: Supported with expectedLanEnvironmentId:null when LAN is absent/empty; do not create an empty LAN home.

previewAdditions.canImportRetainedLanHistory: boolean offer, both homes current schema, selected original, source idle, complete source display/attachment resolution
previewAdditions.historyImportPreview: null or bounded schemaVersion1 domain preview with IDs, review/history generations, summary, providerMappings and baseline semantic proof
previewAdditions.historyImportBlockers: bounded stable reason words, including retained-history-preview-failed on unexpected preview failure
previewAdditions.historyImportRecovery: null normally; pending import cached recovery-only metadata {repairId,phase,receiptPath,sourceEnvironmentId,targetEnvironmentId,reviewGeneration,recoverSupported,rollbackSupported}
previewAdditions.historyImportStorage: null/absent when unavailable (with history-import-storage-unavailable blocker), otherwise bounded {requiredBytes,availableBytes,sufficient}; metadata-only storage estimate reserves3x target home plus source/profile backups, attachments and1GiB margin. Native reevaluates before snapshots; volatile available bytes do not enter reviewGeneration.

historyImport.runtimeCompatibility: Imported attachment IDs remain flat server20-valid identifiers; exact immutable userdata/attachments/<id>.<extension> paths are returned in the transaction manifest. Provider profile/settings data is never merged.
historyImport.proof: Full native workGeneration necessarily changes after append. Domain proof requires identical pre-existing event prefix, every existing projection/receipt row and existing work semantic digest; new settled imported IDs are the only allowed additions. Native pre/post generations are separately bound.
historyImport.publication: Durable home-repair.json blocks startup before snapshots/staging. Closed, checked standalone staged SQLite main is published by same-volume raw-file rename after original main/WAL/SHM quarantine. Exact journal-owned per-attachment partial files are fsynced/hashed before immutable publication; partials are recognized or retained, never silently discarded.
historyImport.crashPreview: Before ANY ordinary home preview or target SQL, detect import journal and return its bounded cached pre-import report with only matching recovery enabled. Recovery validates identities/admission/paths/raw pins first and repairs a coherent SQLite set before target inspection.
historyImport.retention: Fresh snapshots, interrupted stages, partial copies, SQLite quarantines, imported attachment quarantines and public receipts are retained. No automatic destructive cleanup. Original selection/adoption receipt and profiles stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
